title: Breaking: Scientists Discover New Planet
text: Scientists at NASA have announced the discovery of a new exoplanet that could potentially support life. The planet, named Kepler-442b, is located about 112 light-years away from Earth.
subject: science

title: Economy Shows Strong Growth
text: The stock market reached new highs today as economic indicators show continued growth in the manufacturing sector. Analysts predict sustained recovery through the year.
subject: economics

title: Local Election Results Announced
text: City officials released the final vote counts yesterday confirming the election of the new mayor. Voter turnout was reported at 65%.
